body.statement:
Along \(n_\ell=2\ell\) and \(m_\ell=2\lceil\gamma\ell\rceil\), fix \(r,K,q\) and \(\mu>1\), restrict attention to nonempty predictable classes with \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\to0\) on which the hypotheses of Theorem \(\mathrm{thm:adaptive\mbox{-}minimax\mbox{-}lower}\) hold, and write
\[
 R_\ell^\star=
 \inf_{\widetilde U\in\mathfrak E_{n_\ell,m_\ell}}
 \sup_{P\in\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{pred}}_{n_\ell,m_\ell}(r,\mu,K,q,B,\lambda)}
 E_P[\mathcal L(\widetilde U,U)].
\]
Determine whether \(R_\ell^\star\) has order \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\), order one, or an intermediate order inside the proved \(b\)-to-constant bracket.  Decide first whether the \(b\)-normalized quantity \(C_\star\) is finite.  Only if that rate question closes, determine the exact value of \(C_\star\), whether recorded IPW--SVD attains it, and whether a nonconstant predictable propensity path can be least favorable.
body.justification: After the matched-rate claim is removed, the live question is first whether the minimax risk follows \(b_{nm}\), \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\), or an intermediate rate; a sharp constant is meaningful only after that exponent gap closes.
body.gap: Open obligation: construct an observed-data estimator improving the loose upper bound or prove an estimator-independent lower bound larger than \(b_{nm}\), without adding singular-factor predictability or exogeneity.  The current IPW-specific obstruction cannot decide this question.
body.consumer: A resolution would determine the attainable design-budget and signal-strength law before any sharp-constant calculation.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine whether the minimax expected normalized maximum-row loss has order \(b_{nm}\), order one, or an intermediate order on nonempty fixed-complexity predictable classes before computing any normalized sharp constant.
obligation.obstruction: The constant-propensity packing gives only \(c b_{nm}\), while the new hybrid gives only a constant upper endpoint in the nonempty fixed-complexity regime.  The endogenous-target construction lower-bounds recorded IPW--SVD rather than every observed-data estimator.
obligation.attempted: A row-local Fano packing, a matrix-Freedman spectral upper bound, and a deterministic sine-frame fallback have been completed.  Together they close the honest \(b_{nm}\)-to-constant bracket but not its minimax order.
obligation.partial_result: The constant-propensity Fano family proves \(R_\ell^\star\ge c b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\).  The observed-data hybrid proves \(R_\ell^\star\le C(1\wedge a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{n_\ell m_\ell})\).  On a nonempty fixed-complexity bounded-aspect class, bounded outcomes force \(\lambda_{nm}\le2B\sqrt{nm}\); the fixed-complexity scale proposition then gives \(b_{nm}\gtrsim\sqrt{\log n/n}\) and \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm},d_{nm}\gtrsim\sqrt{\log n}\).  Hence the hybrid upper endpoint is only constant in that regime, while the available lower endpoint may vanish.  The endogenous-target witness proves that recorded IPW--SVD can fail at the \(b_{nm}\) scale, but it does not lower-bound the risk of every observed-data estimator.
